name: What should homeowners prepare before starting a bathroom wall tiling project?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners prepare before starting a bathroom wall tiling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling installation, measure your approximate square footage, choose your tile style, and decide if you want custom built-ins like recessed shampoo niches or corner benches. If your remodel involves replacing shower valves or moving showerheads, coordinate the rough plumbing before the wall backer board goes up. Homeowners should also determine whether they plan to reuse existing trim and glass doors or replace them, as tile thickness changes the finished wall depth and affects how enclosures mount.
acceptedAnswer.description: Determine your preferred tile, decide on custom features like niches, and plan any plumbing valve or showerhead changes before wall backer boards are installed.
